data.name: Amliya
data.gender_notes: Amliya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'amal', meaning 'work', and the suffix 'liyah' meaning 'tender, gentle, or kind'. The name Amliya signifies a woman who is diligent, hardworking, and kind-hearted. The name Amliya carries the meaning “Gentle, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Amliya usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amliya is a name that embodies the spiritual qualities of hard work, dedication, and kindness. It is a reminder that our actions in this world have consequences, and that being gentle and kind to others can bring about positive change.
data.etymology: Amliya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amliya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.long_meaning: أملية مشتقة من أمل، وتعني الأمل والتمني للخير والسلام. في اللغة العربية، الأمل هو الرجاء في حصول شيء مرغوب فيه. وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الرجاء في رحمة الله تعالى. تحمل هذه الاسم معاني الأمل والتفاؤل والسلام.

in_hindi.name: अमलिया

in_pashto.name: املې
in_pashto.long_meaning: املې نوم د 'أمل' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د امید او تمنا ده. په پښتنو او افغانانو کې دا نوم مشهور دی او د امیدوار او تمنا کوونکې معنی لري. په اسلامي دود کې، امید او تمنا د ښو کارونو لپاره یو هڅونکی په توګه لیدل کیږي.

in_english.name: Amliya
in_english.meaning: Hope and wish, derived from Arabic root 'أمل'
in_english.long_meaning: Amliya originates from the Arabic root 'أمل' (al-amal), meaning hope and wish. This name is used across Muslim cultures and symbolizes optimism and aspiration. In Islamic tradition, it reflects the believer's hope in Allah's mercy and benevolence. The name Amliya is associated with positive personality traits such as being hopeful, ambitious, and kind-hearted.

It invites the bearer to strive for excellence and persistence in all her pursuits, while maintaining a kind and gentle disposition. The name can also serve as a source of inspiration to be a blessing and a source of goodness to those around her, reflecting the spirit of being a servant of God (Amal wali Allah). And ultimately, it is a call to be mindful of the Hereafter and the eternal rewards for good deeds, as mentioned in the Quran: “And whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it” (99:7).
